title: Guinea Fowl and Donkeys
content: Guinea fowl keets, watercolor, 5 x 8 inchesOver in the barn, they've got another load of hay into the loft. The guinea fowl hatchlings (called keets) have moved into a larger enclosure. Peanut and the other donkeys got their summer haircuts. They spend these hot days in their barn stalls cooling off in front of the fans.
